## Map

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 20
#| fig-height: 10
#| out-width: "100%"
#| fig-align: center

library(leaflet)

df <- read.csv("~/Documents/ATI_website/Data/CM_acoustic_processed.csv")

df_subset <- data.frame(
  lng  = df$Longitude,
  lat  = df$Latitude,
  dsf  = df$Damselfish,
  pfc  = df$Parrotfish_crunch,
  site = df$Site
)

# Shared domain across BOTH signals
shared_domain <- range(
  c(df_subset$dsf, df_subset$pfc),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette = "viridis",
  domain = shared_domain,
  na.color = "transparent"
)

metadata <- paste0(
  "Site ", df_subset$site,
  "<hr>Damselfish: ", ifelse(is.na(df_subset$dsf), "—", round(df_subset$dsf, 3)),
  " (mean calls / min)",
  "<hr>Parrotfish crunch: ", ifelse(is.na(df_subset$pfc), "—", round(df_subset$pfc, 3)),
  " (mean calls / min)"
)

leaflet(df_subset) %>%
  addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldImagery") %>%
  setView(lng = -149.84, lat = -17.5392, zoom = 12) %>%

  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lng, lat = ~lat,
    color = ~pal(dsf),
    radius = 4,
    opacity = 1, fillOpacity = 0.8,
    popup = metadata,
    group = "Damselfish"
  ) %>%

  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lng, lat = ~lat,
    color = ~pal(pfc),
    radius = 4,
    opacity = 1, fillOpacity = 0.8,
    popup = metadata,
    group = "Parrotfish_crunch"
  ) %>%

  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("Damselfish", "Parrotfish_crunch"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) %>%

  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    pal = pal,
    values = shared_domain,
    title = "Mean calls / min",
    opacity = 1
  )

```
